name: Vietnam e-visa
fullName: Vietnam e-visa: portrait photo and passport page
covers: Vietnam e-visa (single or multiple entry, up to 90 days)
Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang and the rest of Vietnam
intro: Vietnam's e-visa is open to citizens of every country and is applied for on one official site, evisa.gov.vn. The form asks for a 4 × 6 cm portrait on a white background and a picture of your passport's photo page. Vietnam's immigration department asks for the portrait to be under 50 KB and the passport picture under 200 KB.

documents.label: Portrait photo
notes: 4 × 6 cm portrait on a plain white background, looking straight at the camera.
No glasses. Take it within the last 6 months.
Under 50 KB, as Vietnam's immigration department asks.

documents.label: Passport photo page
notes: The whole photo page, under 200 KB.
Include the two lines of letters and arrows at the bottom of the page; they must be sharp.
No glare, fingers or shadows over your details.

source.label: Vietnam Immigration Department e-visa guide (file sizes) and the e-visa portal's photo instructions

facts.label: Who can apply
facts.value: Citizens of every country. Some nationalities can visit visa-free for a shorter stay, so check before you apply.

facts.label: Cost
facts.value: USD 25 for a single entry, USD 50 for multiple entries.

facts.label: Processing
facts.value: Usually about 3 working days. Apply at least a week before you fly, and earlier around Tết (Lunar New Year).

steps: Go to evisa.gov.vn, the only official site, and choose the e-visa for foreigners outside Vietnam.
Upload the portrait and passport page you made on this page, and wait for both to be accepted.
Fill in your details exactly as they appear in your passport.
Choose single or multiple entry, your dates, and the airport or border crossing where you'll enter and leave. You must enter through the one you choose.
Pay the fee, and write down your registration code.
Check the result with your code, email and date of birth. When it's approved, download the e-visa and print a copy to carry.
beforeYouFly: Your passport should be valid for at least 6 months after you arrive, with blank pages.
Check that the name, passport number and dates on your e-visa match your passport exactly.

sources.label: Freaking Nomads: Vietnam's 90-day e-visa for all countries (Resolution 127/NQ-CP; fees from the US Embassy in Vietnam)

faqs.q: What is the Vietnam e-visa photo size?
faqs.a: 4 × 6 cm, on a plain white background, looking straight at the camera, with no glasses. Vietnam's immigration department asks for the file to be under 50 KB.

faqs.q: Which website is the official Vietnam e-visa site?
faqs.a: evisa.gov.vn. Many look-alike sites charge extra service fees for the same e-visa.

faqs.q: Can I wear glasses in my Vietnam e-visa photo?
faqs.a: No. Take them off for the photo, and make sure your face is evenly lit with no shadows.
